evals.name: report-content-preservation
evals.prompt: 这是一份季度经营分析报告，不要改任何文字，按中文正式文档格式排版，输出 DOCX 和格式核验报告。
evals.expected_output: A valid DOCX with unchanged text and structure plus a passing verification report.
assertions: All 15 paragraph texts and their order remain identical.
The file opens as a valid DOCX and contains no placeholder text.
Page size is A4 with the configured margins.
Title, body, headings, signature, and date use the configured fonts, sizes, line spacing, alignment, and indents.
The verification report marks content integrity and typography checks as passed.

evals.name: minutes-metadata-preservation
evals.prompt: 这是会议纪要草稿，先判断文种；不明确先问我。保留所有数字、标点和段序。
evals.expected_output: A valid meeting-minutes DOCX with preserved metadata and decision text plus any structural ambiguity called out.
assertions: The document type is identified as meeting minutes.
The metadata block remains top-aligned and unindented.
All 14 paragraph texts and their order remain identical.
The date remains right-aligned with the configured indentation.

evals.name: plan-table-structure
evals.prompt: 这是带表格的实施方案，只调整页面、标题层级和表格格式，不要重做内容，完成后检查结构有没有变化。
evals.expected_output: A valid plan DOCX with the same table content and merged layout plus a passing structure check.
assertions: The document type is identified as a plan.
All paragraph and table-cell texts remain identical.
The merged cell remains merged and spans the same columns.
The table uses the configured header/body fonts, borders, and cell margins.
The verification report marks content integrity, page, typography, and table checks as passed.
